name: The Celestial
summary: A pact with a being of the upper planes that grants healing light.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.short: Healing and radiant spells join your warlock list.
features.summary: The Celestial adds these spells to the warlock spell list for you; learn them like other warlock spells.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.summary: You learn the Light and Sacred Flame cantrips. They count as warlock cantrips for you.

features.name: Healing Light
features.short: Bonus action: heal with a pool of d6s.
features.summary: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. As a bonus action, spend up to CHA-modifier dice from the pool to heal a creature within 60 ft. by the total. The pool refills on a long rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.short: Resist radiant; add CHA to one fire or radiant damage roll.
features.summary: You have resistance to radiant damage. When you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, add your CHA modifier to one damage roll against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.short: You and allies gain temp HP after a rest.
features.summary: When you finish a short or long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + CHA, and up to five creatures gain half your warlock level + CHA.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.short: Rise from a death save with half HP and blind nearby foes.
features.summary: When you make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring up with half your hit points and deal 2d8 + CHA radiant damage to creatures of your choice within 30 ft., blinding them. Once per long rest.
